classTag.zh: 從好奇心出發的研究者

intro.en: My master's research started with a question: could AI make plant health support more accessible?
intro.zh: 研究所時，我開始思考：AI 能不能讓植物健康辨識更容易被一般人使用？

evidence.en: Plantman combined computer vision, smartphone use and a LINE bot to bring tomato disease research closer to everyday scenarios.
evidence.zh: Plantman 結合電腦視覺、手機與 LINE Bot，嘗試讓番茄病害研究走向實際使用情境。

takeaway.en: Research matters when it can reach someone outside the lab.
takeaway.zh: 研究的價值，不只在論文指標，也在能否走出實驗室。

detail.zh: 經歷：臺大碩士研究 · Plantman

classTag.zh: 在限制中找解法的研究者

intro.en: When GPU memory limits long-video tracking, I don't stop at the constraint. I rethink the processing flow.
intro.zh: 長影片追蹤碰到 GPU 記憶體限制時，我會重新拆解流程，而不只是說做不到。

evidence.en: I explored chunked SAM2 video tracking and memory management to make longer workflows practical on constrained GPUs.
evidence.zh: 我透過 SAM2 分段追蹤與記憶體管理，嘗試讓有限 GPU 資源也能支援更長的影片流程。

takeaway.en: Progress often comes from changing the approach, not just adding hardware.
takeaway.zh: 進展有時來自重新設計方法，而不是單純增加硬體。

detail.en: Evidence: SAM2 long-video tracking · performance tuning
detail.zh: 經歷：SAM2 長影片追蹤 · 效能優化

classTag.zh: 讓想法真正落地的實作者

skill.zh: 傾聽 → 實作 → 迭代

intro.en: Before building an AI tool, I start by understanding what the people using it actually need.
intro.zh: 做 AI 工具之前，我會先了解第一線使用者真正要解決什麼問題。

evidence.en: In manufacturing AI projects, I turn ambiguous operational needs into testable steps, lightweight tools and feedback-driven revisions.
evidence.zh: 在製造業 AI 專案中，我把模糊的現場需求整理成可驗證步驟、可使用工具，再根據回饋調整。

takeaway.en: A working solution beats a sophisticated demo nobody uses.
takeaway.zh: 能被真正使用的方案，比只有技術展示的原型更有價值。

detail.en: Evidence: manufacturing AI implementation · workflow tools
detail.zh: 經歷：製造業 AI 導入 · 工作流程工具

intro.en: Underwater, curiosity needs to be balanced with preparation, awareness and respect for limits.
intro.zh: 在水下，光有好奇心不夠，還需要事前準備、環境觀察與尊重風險。

evidence.en: I learned scuba and freediving and trained as a lifeguard—different skills, all built on deliberate practice and safety.
evidence.zh: 我接觸水肺潛水、自由潛水，也接受救生員訓練。不同技能都需要扎實練習與安全意識。

takeaway.en: Adaptability means learning the rules of a new environment before pushing forward.
takeaway.zh: 適應未知，先理解環境與規則，再逐步拓展能力。

detail.en: Evidence: PADI OW · AIDA 2 · certified lifeguard
detail.zh: 經歷：PADI OW · AIDA 2 · 救生員資格

skill.zh: 練習 → 修正 → 再挑戰

intro.en: In the ring, every mistake becomes immediate feedback. Improvement comes from using it.
intro.zh: 站上擂台，每個失誤都會得到直接回饋；關鍵是下一次怎麼調整。

evidence.en: I won freshman competitions in Sanda and fencing, and continue challenging myself through boxing and bouldering.
evidence.zh: 我曾獲得散打與擊劍新生盃冠軍，也持續透過拳擊、抱石挑戰自己。

takeaway.en: Resilience is not ignoring failure; it's training for the next attempt.
takeaway.zh: 韌性不是忽略失敗，而是把回饋帶進下一次練習。

detail.en: Evidence: Sanda & fencing freshman champions · boxing
detail.zh: 經歷：散打與擊劍新生盃冠軍 · 拳擊

intro.en: A long journey doesn't require knowing every step from the start—just the willingness to keep learning along the way.
intro.zh: 長途旅行不需要一開始就知道所有答案，但需要願意每天前進、邊走邊調整。

evidence.en: Walking the Camino de Santiago taught me how much progress depends on pace, flexibility and showing up each day.
evidence.zh: 走 Camino de Santiago 朝聖之路時，我學到如何安排節奏、適應變化，並在長程目標中持續前進。

takeaway.en: Big goals become manageable when you focus on the next meaningful step.
takeaway.zh: 很大的目標，可以從下一個可行步驟開始。

detail.zh: 經歷：Camino de Santiago 朝聖之路

classTag.zh: 因為遊戲而開始寫程式

intro.en: Before AI, before engineering work, there was a simple 2D spaceship game.
intro.zh: 在 AI 與工程工作之前，最早讓我開始寫程式的是一款簡單的 2D 太空船遊戲。

evidence.en: In high school, I joined a software seed training program, and my first programming assignment was to build a spaceship game.
evidence.zh: 高中時，我主動參加軟體種子培訓計畫，第一個作業就是製作 2D 太空船遊戲。

takeaway.en: Games are not an add-on to my career story. They are where it began.
takeaway.zh: 遊戲不是履歷上的額外興趣，而是我開始接觸程式的原因。

detail.en: Evidence: high-school software training · first 2D game
detail.zh: 經歷：高中軟體培訓 · 第一款 2D 遊戲

skill.zh: 視野 → 時機 → 合作

intro.en: My favorite support role is about shaping the fight before it starts.
intro.zh: 我喜歡的輔助玩法，不是被動保護隊友，而是先創造好的戰鬥條件。

evidence.en: Playing Pyke in League of Legends taught me to think about vision control, roaming and choosing when to engage for the team.
evidence.zh: 在英雄聯盟玩派克時，我特別在意視野、遊走，以及判斷何時為團隊開戰。

takeaway.en: Leadership can mean helping the team win without being the center of attention.
takeaway.zh: 領導有時不是自己成為最亮眼的人，而是創造讓團隊成功的條件。

detail.en: Evidence: League of Legends · support/jungle · Pyke main
detail.zh: 經歷：英雄聯盟 · 輔助／打野 · 派克玩家

classTag.zh: 關注玩家體驗的觀察者

intro.en: I keep returning to games with friends. The people we play with are often part of what makes a game memorable.
intro.zh: 我常因為朋友相約而回到遊戲。遊戲吸引人的地方，有時也是一起玩的那些人。

evidence.en: In CS2, I enjoy the coordination and social side of competitive play. It sparked an interest in why players return and what makes multiplayer experiences stick.
evidence.zh: 在 CS2，我喜歡競技協作，也留意朋友連線如何影響玩家回流，以及多人遊戲的吸引力。

takeaway.en: A game is a system—and an experience shared between people.
takeaway.zh: 遊戲既是一套系統，也是玩家與玩家之間共同創造的體驗。

detail.en: Evidence: CS2 with friends · interest in game operations
detail.zh: 經歷：CS2 朋友連線 · 對遊戲營運的興趣
